description: A workbook's sheets, one action a call: add (name, position), rename (sheet, name: every reference rewritten), clear (Clear All: references to it stay; regenerate a sheet this way), delete (refused while anything refers to it, listing what; force: #REF!), hide, unhide.

force.description: delete: write #REF! into what refers to it. clear: into formulas naming its tables.

name.description: add, rename: the new name (31 characters at most).

position.description: add: 1 is the first tab; default the end.

name: xlsx_manage_sheets
